the board.units: only when the read beats the real price (the money check), sized by what won in the replay (10/30): the Lock 2u, 1u when its own read runs 7+ points over the market, college football Locks 1u, NFL Locks 0.5u and never the star (11/16; a Lock needs 56%+); the Dog 2u at +100..+150, 0.5u longer; every value play 0.5u, moneyline only; from 11/17 (the max-profit sizing): the hockey runner-up dog at +100..+150 2u, the college football thin Lock 1u, the star 2u on a Lock / a Dog of the Day / a play that is 1u+ by its own size at +150 or shorter (1u at least on anything else)
the board.max play: 💎 3u - the hockey Dog of the Day when the dog is rested, the favorite played last night and the dog score is 8+ (several things agreeing, never one factor); a label on the Dog, never an extra pick; about 17 a hockey season; off at 25 graded under 44% won (11/16)
the board.leans: NONE - the engine posts no leans and keeps no leans record (the owner, 11/16: leans out of existence); every pick on the board carries units
